description: Identify content gaps — topics the brand's competitors cover but the brand doesn't. Returns short detail by default: {id?, topic?, keyword?} labels only per gap. Use detail="medium" for compact gaps (+ searchVolume, difficulty, competitorDomains) or detail="full" for the raw API response.

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "short". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

name: seo_gap
